mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notify_log (channel_id, channel_name, event, title, status, response_code, response_body, error_msg, payload, created_at) VALUES (#{channelId}, #{channelName}, #{event}, #{title}, #{status}, #{responseCode}, #{responseBody,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{errorMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{payload,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notify_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
